unknown_policy: Keep raw values and descriptive aggregates, but exclude unknown semantic kinds from inferential ranking. No suffix or value-shape guessing.

avg_time.provenance: documented application average-latency field; compare only within this field

num.provenance: documented requests per metric_app sample window

succee_num.provenance: documented successful requests per metric_app sample window

directions.direction_note: Custom metrics without an explicit source direction use two-sided contrasts; this is a detection choice, not an assumption that every increase/decrease causes faults.

counter_transform.name: reset-aware first difference
counter_transform.rate_unit: source counter delta per elapsed minute
counter_transform.reset_rule: A negative difference is treated as a reset to zero; use the current value divided by elapsed minutes as the post-reset rate.
counter_transform.first_sample: No rate is emitted without a preceding sample inside the case reference+alert view.
counter_transform.wraparound: Not inferred; a negative difference is a reset, not a guessed wrap.
counter_transform.raw_values: Preserved in MetricPoint and referenced by series/source row counts.

external_primary_source.used_for: The Redis INFO documentation identifies total_commands_processed/total_connections_received as totals, instantaneous_ops_per_sec as commands per second, and used_cpu_sys/user as consumed CPU. Exact Redis mappings are applied only to matching observed names.

provenance_note: Explicit names are taken from the public Telecom schema and fixed development clip headers. Redis total/rate distinctions cite the primary Redis INFO documentation. Other custom container/node/service semantics are stated reconstruction assumptions. No classification is selected using scored-case labels; names absent from these lists remain unknown.
